title: The economy: one year opened into a land

steps.title: The road of time
steps.text: Time runs along the road: 4996 lines of 100,000 people above the wall of 25 industries that pay them. At the road's end, one year opens into a land.

steps.title: The cut through 2025
steps.text: Cut the road at 2025: every industry's band of the wall, and the 2,742 adult lives that pierce the year, each a dot.

steps.title: Where value is created
steps.text: The cut lies back and curls into a bowl: government is the floor, tech the highest terrace, the people on the rim. Each industry's area is the value it adds: one square is $1.28T a year. Gold is the owners' share.

steps.title: What each industry stands on
steps.text: Under every terrace, roots: what each industry buys from the others, $15.85T a year, rising into the buyer from below. 37% of it comes from a supplier on a higher terrace.

steps.title: Where value is captured
steps.text: Gold is what owners keep. Payouts rise into the crown, $5.33T a year, and fall on those who own. The towers are the most valuable companies; the four chip and device makers earn 9.2 times what the US hardware industry's owners keep.

steps.title: Who stands where
steps.text: 116 players of the 12 groups of 2026, each about 2.2 million people, standing above whoever pays them. Each dot is a line from the road; gold dots are the people in control of their path.

steps.title: Where the money goes
steps.text: Spending runs down from the rim into the industries that are paid: $21.63T a year. Ice is money spent away from fear: 54% of it. Rose is money spent toward desire; glitter is fantasy.

steps.title: Desire, fear and fantasy
steps.text: Mirages are fantasy: 19% of spending, and as much for the 12% in control as for the rest. What sets them apart is reason, 0.70 against 0.36, and where their money comes from.

steps.title: How people organize
steps.text: Tit for tat between the players: strangers open at 0.333, and forgiveness lets cooperation climb to 0.686 in 12 rounds. Four coalitions form along the land, not along party.

steps.title: One betrayal
steps.text: One betrayal echoes back and forth between two players; forgiveness ends it after 7 rounds. If nobody forgave, the whole season would settle at 0.425 instead of 0.729.

steps.title: The land in 1972
steps.text: 1972: the making terrace was 80% full and services 54%; strangers opened at 0.584 and cooperation reached 0.795.

steps.title: Any year
steps.text: Pick any year with , and . and open it: the land rebuilds for that year. Click a player, a tower or a lifeline to see who they are.
